calibration: untrained expert assumptions; sensitivity envelope is NOT a credible or confidence interval
hypothesis: Removing this module violates at least one retained capability under the specified contract; not workload hit frequency
fusion_assumption: One joint Bayes factor per declared evidence group; factors across groups are assumed conditionally independent given necessity. This assumption is not established by current data.

static_result_use.meaning: P(discarded result and bounded consumer evidence | necessary) / P(evidence | unnecessary); manual assumption, not a learned likelihood

differential_campaign.meaning: Joint contribution of the entire original comparison campaign, including repeated timing calls; not one update per passing test

utility.unit: illustrative millisecond-equivalent utility per workflow; correctness loss is a policy weight, not measured latency

probes.status: hypothetical diagnostic performance; not calibrated or executed
